themes.title: Cyberpunk
themes.prompt: Take a picture in a cyberpunk style with neon colors, tech elements, and futuristic vibes.

themes.title: Caricature
themes.prompt: Take a picture and make it a caricature. Defined by exaggerated features, bold expressions, and a humorous twist while preserving likeness. It captures the essence of a person or scene in a fun, over-the-top way, like something you would get from a street artist at a fair, bursting with personality and charm.

themes.title: Van Gogh
themes.prompt: Take a picture and make it look like a Van Gogh painting, with bold brushstrokes, vibrant colors, and emotional intensity. Capture the essence of the subject while infusing it with the unique style and energy that Van Gogh is known for.

themes.title: Pixel Art
themes.prompt: Take a picture and convert it into pixel art style, characterized by its blocky, low-resolution aesthetic. The image should be transformed into a grid of pixels, with simplified shapes and a limited color palette, reminiscent of classic video game graphics.

themes.title: Watercolor
themes.prompt: Take a picture and render it in a watercolor style, featuring soft, flowing brushstrokes, subtle color blending, and a dreamy, ethereal quality. The image should evoke the delicate and translucent nature of traditional watercolor paintings.

themes.title: Pop Art
themes.prompt: Take a picture and transform it into a pop art style, characterized by bold colors, strong lines, and a sense of irony or satire. The image should be reminiscent of the works of artists like Andy Warhol and Roy Lichtenstein, with a focus on popular culture and mass media.

themes.title: Surrealism
themes.prompt: Take a picture and transform it into a surrealist style, characterized by dream-like scenes, unexpected juxtapositions, and imaginative elements. The image should evoke a sense of wonder and challenge the viewer's perception of reality.

themes.title: Huklify
themes.prompt: Take a picture and apply the Hulkify theme, which exaggerates features and adds a green tint to create a fun and playful transformation. The image should capture the essence of the original while giving it a humorous and larger-than-life appearance, reminiscent of the Hulk character from comics and movies.

themes.title: 1950s Seaside Postcard
themes.prompt: Take a picture and transform it into a 1950s seaside postcard style, characterized by bright, saturated colors, a slightly faded or distressed look, and a nostalgic, vintage feel. The image should evoke the charm and simplicity of mid-20th century beach scenes, with elements like sandy shores, ocean waves, and classic beach attire.

themes.title: Film Noir
themes.prompt: Take a picture and transform it into a film noir style, characterized by high contrast, dramatic lighting, and a moody, atmospheric quality. The image should evoke the dark and gritty aesthetic of classic film noir movies, with deep shadows, stark highlights, and a sense of mystery and intrigue.

themes.title: Steampunk
themes.prompt: Take a picture and transform it into a steampunk style, characterized by a blend of Victorian-era aesthetics and steam-powered technology. The image should evoke a sense of retro-futurism, with elements like gears, cogs, brass fittings, and an overall industrial yet whimsical vibe.

themes.title: Ghibli
themes.prompt: Take a picture and transform it into the style of Studio Ghibli, characterized by its whimsical and detailed animation. The image should evoke the magical and heartwarming aesthetic of Ghibli films, with soft colors, intricate backgrounds, and a sense of wonder and nostalgia.

themes.title: 1970s Saucy Postcard
themes.prompt: Take a picture and transform it into a vintage British seaside comic postcard style: bold cartoon illustration, exaggerated expressions, bright flat colours, cheeky innuendo, playful humour, buxom characters, henpecked husbands, bustling promenade atmosphere, 1960s–70s saucy postcard aesthetic, simple layout with a punchline vibe, lighthearted and mischievous tone as provided by artists like Donald McGill and Stanley James, capturing the nostalgic charm and cheeky humor of classic British seaside postcards.

themes.title: Startrek TNG
themes.prompt: Take a picture and transform it into the style of Star Trek: The Next Generation, characterized by its futuristic and sleek design elements. The image should evoke the aesthetic of the 24th century, with clean lines, advanced technology, and a sense of exploration and optimism. Style cues can be drawn from the show's iconic uniforms, starship interiors, and the overall visual language of the series.

themes.title: Professional
themes.prompt: Take a picture and apply a professional theme, which emphasizes clarity, composition, and a polished appearance, focus and lighting. The image should containt as much of the original while giving it a refined and sophisticated look, suitable for professional presentations and portfolios.
